## Get in touch

Interested in our research, becoming a partner, or bringing Antarctic science to a wider audience? We would be pleased to hear from you.

Please tell us a little about yourself and what you have in mind.

We will get back to you using the email address you provide.
:::

::: {.contact-panel}
```{=html}
<form action="https://form.taxi/s/oixkgqds" class="project-contact-form" method="POST" accept-charset="utf-8">
  <p class="contact-required-note">Fields marked * are required.</p>

  <label for="contact-name">Name *</label>
  <input type="text" name="Name" id="contact-name" autocomplete="name" maxlength="150" required>

  <label for="contact-email">Email address *</label>
  <input type="email" name="Email" id="contact-email" autocomplete="email" maxlength="254" required>

  <label for="contact-organisation">Organisation <span class="contact-optional">(optional)</span></label>
  <input type="text" name="Organisation" id="contact-organisation" autocomplete="organization" maxlength="200">

  <label for="contact-message">Your message *</label>
  <textarea rows="7" name="Message" id="contact-message" maxlength="10000" required></textarea>

  <label class="contact-consent" for="contact-consent">
    <input type="checkbox" name="Data processing confirmed" id="contact-consent" value="Yes" required>
    <span>I agree to the processing of my entries to respond to my enquiry. See our <a href="privacy.html">Privacy information</a>. *</span>
  </label>

  <div class="contact-honeypot" aria-hidden="true">
    <label for="contact-website">Leave this field empty</label>
    <input type="text" name="_gotcha" id="contact-website" value="" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off">
  </div>

  <button type="submit">Send enquiry</button>
  <p class="contact-service-note">Messages are submitted through Form.taxi. After sending, you will see a submission confirmation.</p>
</form>
```
:::
